title: Yes, Lamb. i’ll Goon for You.
description:
Each week on Patreon I set little tasks that sometimes end up turning into sexy little mini trances, and I liked this one enough that I thought I’d make it a proper file and corrupt you all.

This file is all about enjoying yourself by gooning.

I could have just told you to goon…

But it’s sexier when I hypnotise you into being a gooner.

This file uses yes sets, repetition, snaps, drops, subliminals and lots of lovely little suggestions to get you agreeing with me that pleasure is good, mindlessness is bliss, and gooning sounds like a very sensible use of your time.

And then, when you’re mindless and horny, I give you your task: plan a date night for yourself.

A proper, disgustingly indulgent goon night where the whole point is to overwhelm yourself with as much pleasure as you can cram into it and become a completely porn-brained little gooner.

Ultimately, I want you to goon. I want you to enjoy pleasure to the highest and most ecstatic levels imaginable….

Just as a lil treat.

You get to spend days thinking about gooning before you even get to the night where I actually told you to goon. You can listen to a Gooner Brainwashing Loops on your date night.

Very efficient corruption, really.

Happy gooning. As always, this file is an erotic hypnosis fantasy and is best enjoyed with an understanding of subject agency. For more information on subject agency, MuttHypno has an excellent and comprehensive writing on Building Subject Agency Each week, we do writing lines on my Patreon. The PFP is the lines written by a very, very good boy.
